messages:
Ravi P: FYI pushed Bellwether LoRA merge into int4_v3 nightly. Quick generation smoke shows weird punctuation collapse in address fields (commas disappearing / run-together addresses).

Clara W: Oof. Do we have a quick eval for structured-extract or an address exact-match metric?

Ravi P: ran a 100-ex sample (bellwether-address-100) with rwd-gen-check. eval-bot posted short results: 
```
rwd-gen-check v1.4
run: bellwether-lora-int4v3-smoke-2026-03-21
dataset: bellwether-address-100
metric: address_exact_match (baseline=fp16)
baseline fp16: EM=0.94
int4_v3: EM=0.66
delta=-0.28
note: punctuation-loss observed ("," -> ""), multiple tokens concatenated at street/apt boundaries
```

Jules: That delta is big. Could be tokenization alignment or quant bucket for comma/whitespace token embeddings. Any tokenizer or merge code changes?

Marta: Merge was pure LoRA weights (customer fine-tune) — no tokenizer edits in repo. But int4_v3 packaging changed group-packing (reordered low-entropy buckets).

Clara W: Can you repro on int4_v2 and int8? We need isolation (quant vs LoRA).

Jules: ran quick shadows: int8 EM=0.93, int4_v2 EM=0.89. So int4_v3 is the outlier again.

Ravi P: here's the exact repro command I used: `./tools/rwd-gen-check --model bellwether-lora-v1 --quant int4_v3 --dataset bellwether-address-100 --metric address_exact_match --n 100` -> EM 0.66.

eval-bot: Dashboard entry: https://console.redwood/evals/2001 (tags: generation-regression, customer-impact-high)

Marta: I pulled token-level logits for examples where commas are missing. Looks like token id for ',' (token 17) probability mass moved into token 1023 (subword-pair) after packing. Packing map difference: int4_v2->int4_v3 shows comma mapped to packed-slot 14 instead of 6.

Clara W: So not LoRA parameter drift: packing remap changed which quant-slot holds punctuation vectors. That can change rounding behavior during dequant.

Jules: Actionable: 1) pause int4_v3 rollout for Bellwether 2) rollback to int4_v2 3) file quant-compiler ticket with packing diff and example ids 4) add targeted test for punctuation/whitespace tokens to regression suite.

Ravi P: Paused rollout and notified CS. Roll command used: `rwd-deploy pause --model bellwether-lora-v1 --quant int4_v3 --env nightly --reason "punctuation-gen-regress"`

ops-bot: Pause confirmed on nightly cluster (job 8472).

Marta: Opening ticket: QC-quant-3382. Attaching 6 failing examples and packing diff. Also adding a small unit-test in quant-ci that forces punctuation examples through packed decoder path.

Clara W: For immediate mitigation we should add a lightweight downstream postprocess fix in routing: if model==bellwether && quant==int4_v3 then apply punctuation-normalizer post-step until compiler patch lands. Low-risk and reversible. Thoughts?

Jules: I can land a temporary postprocess hook in the shadow runtime for nightly only. Will feature-flag it.

Ravi P: Please include guidance for SE comms: short note to customer: "We've paused the new int4 variant for your model and reverted to the previous quantization to preserve address parsing behavior. Investigating packing remap in quant compiler."

eval-bot: Follow-up run queued after rollback: https://console.redwood/evals/2002

Marta: Thanks. Also adding a regression test to eng-ml/quant-notes: "punctuation-token stability checks for customer LoRAs" with example harness commands.

Clara W: Nice triage. Once compiler team posts a fix, we'll re-run full quickpack including address and invoice suites before any rollout.

Ravi P: Closing for now. I'll update the ticket with any CS responses. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
